fusions.name: Choice Cut
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A carving strike that deals 8 damage, heals you for 20% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bigger Than the Stomach
fusions.desc: You sweep a 4-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 26 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to everything in it and leaving it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Leftovers
fusions.desc: Draws on every body within 9 tiles, up to 5; each restores 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Next Course
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
